info.name: Alipacino Inventory API
info.description:
All inventory-related endpoints (categories, items, transactions, suppliers, stock conversions, recipes) for the Alipacino Laravel backend.

Auth: Sanctum Bearer token. Login first via your main Auth collection, then set the `token` collection variable to the returned access token.

Roles allowed: super_admin, hq_admin, branch_admin, inventory_manager (categories/items/transactions/suppliers/stock-conversions); recipes additionally allow super_admin, hq_admin, branch_admin.

request.description: Filters: branch_id, category_id, type (raw_material|prepared), status, low_stock_only, search, sort_by, sort_direction, all, per_page
Create a raw-material inventory item without an image (JSON body).
Same as Create, but using multipart/form-data to also attach an item image via the 'image' file field.

formdata.value: 4oz beef patties made from minced beef

request.description: Stat cards: total_items, low_stock_items, out_of_stock_items, total_stock_value (with 7-day change percent).
KPI overview: stock_value, inventory_turnover, low_stock_alerts, out_of_stock, avg_daily_consumption, top_selling_product, damaged_wasted_items, sales_from_stock.
Streams a CSV file. Same filters as List Inventory Items.
Moves quantity from this item's branch to another branch, creating the item there if needed.
transaction_type: purchase, sale, waste, adjustment, restock. Automatically adjusts item quantity & status.
Deducts `quantity` from inventory_item_id and adds the same quantity to converted_item_id.
Reverses the old stock impact and re-applies the new values.
Also reverses this conversion's stock impact.
Preview only, doesn't move stock. Uses the target item's stored pack_size/yield_qty ratio when configured, else 1:1.
Converts N packs of a prepared item's raw material using the prepared item's own made_from_item_id/pack_size/yield_qty ratio. Creates a stock_conversions record and moves stock.
